content: After annotation, we remove some illegal sentences reported by the annotators. Finally, we have 16,948 sentences annotated by the students. Table 1 shows the information of annotated data. The average Kappa value among the annotators is 0.6033, indicating that the crowd annotators have moderate agreement on identifying entities on this data.
